title: Notify or register skin penetration and beauty services
what: Notify, register or license premises that provide skin penetration or other higher-risk beauty services.

sources.title: Public Health and Wellbeing Act 2008 (Vic)
sources.publisher: Victorian Legislation (authorised version saved by the owner)
sources.locator: s 69(1) (authorised version 071, saved by the owner)
sources.quote: (1) Unless subsection (2) or (3) applies, a person conducting a business referred to in section 68 must, in accordance with Division 4, register, on a periodic basis, any premises upon which that person conducts that business with the Council in whose municipal district the premises are located.

confidence_note: Quoted from the authorised PDF the owner saved from the Victorian register (data/raw/vic_legislation/, not committed); the register's documents disallow automated fetching. Higher-risk services register periodically (s 69); lower-risk services once (s 69A).

assessment.summary: Premises providing skin penetration and other higher-risk personal services must be registered, notified or licensed, and meet hygiene standards.

marks.reason: Registration or notification, inspections and infection-control standards.
